text:
jane_acme: Hey team — we have a customer report: streaming responses cut off mid-token after a reconnection. Client shows partial last event and then a 401 on the follow-up request. Happens only when traffic goes through Cloudflare WAF + ALB in front of our origin. Happening ~3-4x/day.

maria_support: Thanks @jane_acme — can you share repro steps and any request/response logs? Is the client reconnecting automatically or user-initiated?

jane_acme: Auto reconnection from customer mobile app. Repro steps they provided: 1) open SSE stream to /v1/chat/stream 2) idle for ~75s 3) then they see an initial partial payload, then stream stops; client reconnect -> 401 on new POST. They sent a curl snippet: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.example.com/v1/chat/stream``` response shows final chunk truncated.

kevin_sre: 75s is suspicious — ALB default idle is 60s but CF can be different. Could be an idle probe + WAF buffering interaction. Do we have the origin logs and CF ray IDs for a sample?

jane_acme: Sent three ray IDs in the escalation email (ray: 63a3... etc) and an HAR capture. Attaching small excerpt: ```HTTP/1.1 200 OK
transfer-encoding: chunked
data: {"id":"tok_...","delta":"The quick brown"}
data: {"delta":" fox..."}
<FINISH> truncated```. Then on reconnect: ```HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
content-type: application/json
{"error":"invalid_token"}```

maria_support: @kevin_sre can you check if WAF is doing any response body inspection or response buffering for those ray IDs? CF has a setting that can buffer responses when WAF rules trigger. Also ask customer: are they using "sticky" client IPs or behind a mobile carrier NAT?

kevin_sre: Looking at CF logs for ray 63a3... I see a WAF rule (OWASP 942330) matched briefly for a chunk pattern; CF returned 200 but flagged the request. CF also shows origin keepalive reset shortly after 72s. Origin ALB logs show a TCP FIN from ALB to origin at ~72s of idle. This lines up with client idle -> ALB idle timeout -> half-close; CF may buffer the last chunk until it sees EOF and then forward an incomplete chunk to client.

tj_oncall: Hypothesis: ALB idle close at 60s drains connection mid-chunk; CF in front holds connection and tries to do a read-to-eof which causes partial final chunk to be delivered and then client reconnect sees stale/missing auth because token rotation occurred or cookie-based auth was lost. Two mitigations to try: 1) customer sets application-level heartbeat (ping comment every 30s) OR 2) increase ALB idle timeout to >120s OR 3) set cf proxy buffering off for that route.

jane_acme: Customer asked for minimum change. They can add app heartbeat but prefer server-side fix. Can we patch our streaming endpoint to send a small keepalive comment every 20s?

kevin_sre: Quick workaround we can push: add lightweight SSE "":heartbeat comment every 20s from our runtime before final chunk. That prevents ALB idle from reaching the half-close while a long think is happening. Also add logic to accept a reconnect within a small grace window using the same conversation token (avoid immediate 401 if token just rotated).

eng-triage-bot: Note created: INC-2026-1284. Assigning to eng-runtime for a heartbeat rollout and to infra for ALB timeout review.

maria_support: I will send customer a triage response: summary, cause hypothesis (ALB idle + CF WAF buffering + token rotation race), immediate workarounds (set heartbeat, increase ALB idle, disable CF response buffering on route), and ETA for server-side heartbeat patch. :thumbsup:

cloudflare_bot: Suggestion from CF: set `cache: no-transform` and disable `Response Buffering` in the Cloudflare dashboard for streaming endpoints. Also recommend checking "Bot Fight Mode" — it can sometimes throttle long-lived connections.

jane_acme: Thanks all — I'll relay options. Can we get an ETA on heartbeat patch? If we can ship a small change to runtime this week that would be ideal.

kevin_sre: I can coordinate a small rollout to dedicated infra tomorrow — risk low, it's just periodic comment emission at low qps. Will follow up with canary metrics for latency and token churn.

maria_support: Perfect. Closing loop with customer and will update the incident ticket with config steps and repro. If they can share a pcap or full HAR I'll attach to INC-2026-1284.
